description: Field-id extension ranges shared across every SB-Trace v1 object schema.

ranges.description: Reserved for the SB-Trace specification. Allocated only by the spec authors. Readers MUST recognise every core id.
Owned by a named, registered capability frame. A reader MUST recognise an id in this range iff the corresponding capability is mandatory and supported.
Vendor-private and pre-standardisation use. Readers MUST ignore unknown ids in this range. Two writers using overlapping ids is a private agreement, not a spec conflict.
Reserved for future SB-Trace major versions. A v1 writer MUST NOT emit any field with an id in this range; a v1 reader MUST reject any frame that does.

forbidden_ids.reason: Zero is the implicit default in many compact encodings (CBOR, protobuf-lite). Never assignable.

notes: Field ids are 16-bit unsigned integers. They are stable forever and never reused, even after a field is deprecated or removed.
